description: 8-week internship where I built the AI Knowledge & HR Copilot from scratch — a full-stack pnpm monorepo combining a RAG-based knowledge base with structured HR workflows. Implemented the document embedding and vector-search pipeline, a two-layer hallucination-refusal system, CV extraction, and candidate scoring with role-based access control.

highlights: Built the entire AI Knowledge & HR Copilot end to end as the primary backend engineer — from database schema to deployed API
Shipped a working RAG pipeline: document ingestion, chunking, embedding generation, and HNSW-indexed vector search on pgvector
Designed a two-layer hallucination-refusal system so the assistant stays silent instead of inventing answers outside its sources
Delivered a deterministic 0-100 candidate scoring algorithm layered on top of Gemini CV extraction — no LLM in the scoring decision
Added unit tests and E2E tests running against a live database, wired into the GitLab CI pipeline
responsibilities: Designed and implemented the RAG-based knowledge base with document chunking and embedding pipeline
Built HNSW-indexed vector search with pgvector and cosine similarity
Implemented a two-layer hallucination-refusal system for reliable AI responses
Developed CV extraction pipeline using Gemini JSON-schema mode
Built onboarding checklists grounded in company documents
Enforced RBAC with team-scoped manager permissions across every HR endpoint
Documented the API with Swagger and set up Jest unit tests plus E2E tests against a live database
details.contributions: Built the AI Knowledge & HR Copilot from scratch as the primary backend engineer. Implemented the entire RAG pipeline, vector search, hallucination prevention, CV extraction, and HR workflow features.

description: 8-week internship contributing to a production healthcare SaaS platform. Owned the electronic prescription and localization areas of the MVP — QR-verified pharmacy fulfillment, concurrency-safe dispensing, and real-time doctor-patient messaging — with role-based access control across five user roles.

highlights: Owned two full domains of a production healthcare MVP — prescriptions and localization — as a solo contributor on a shared codebase
Implemented the QR-verified pharmacy workflow end to end: code generation, scan verification, and versioned fulfillment tracking
Built concurrency-safe dispensing logic so parallel pharmacy requests cannot oversell a stock batch
Contributed real-time doctor-patient messaging over WebSocket/STOMP to the live platform
Shipped features under GitLab CI/CD with Liquibase-managed schema migrations and Swagger documentation
responsibilities: Developed electronic prescription features including QR code generation and versioned fulfillment tracking
Built pharmacy module components with inventory management and concurrency-safe dispensing logic
Implemented real-time doctor-patient messaging using WebSocket/STOMP
Contributed to appointment scheduling with doctor availability management
Localized the user interface with i18next across the modules I owned
Worked with role-based access control for five distinct user roles
details.contributions: Owned the prescription and localization areas of the MedFlow MVP. Implemented QR-verified pharmacy workflows and contributed to the real-time messaging system.

description: End-of-studies internship where I delivered the TravelTun mobile application and its web admin interface — a Flutter cross-platform client backed by Firebase services for authentication, data, and real-time updates.

highlights: Delivered a shipped Flutter application covering iOS and Android from a single codebase
Built the companion web admin dashboard used to manage listings, users, and bookings
Integrated Firebase end to end — authentication, Firestore, Cloud Storage, and real-time updates
Implemented the booking, review, and payment flows connecting travelers with local tourism businesses
responsibilities: Developed cross-platform mobile application using Flutter
Built web-based admin dashboard for content and user management
Integrated Firebase services for authentication, database, and storage
Implemented real-time features using Firebase Cloud Firestore
Implemented booking, review, and payment flows in the mobile client
details.contributions: Delivered the TravelTun mobile application and admin interface, integrating Firebase services for a complete tourism platform.
